title: The conserved two-component systems CutRS and CssRS control the protein secretion stress response in Streptomyces species
authors: McLean TC; Beaton A; Holmes NA; Martins C; Saalbach G; Chandra G; Batey SF; China J; Wilkinson B; Hutchings MI
one_liner_zh: 该文研究链霉菌双组分系统CutRS调控蛋白分泌应激反应，涉及CutR-DNA结合但未聚焦TF-DNA互作机制，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅实验表征，与课题关联较弱。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

Streptomyces secondary metabolites account for over half of all clinically used antibiotics, as well as numerous antifungal agents, anticancer compounds, and immunosuppressants. Two-component systems, which are widespread in bacteria, are key regulators of antibiotic production in Streptomyces species, yet their activating signals remain poorly understood. CutRS was the first two-component system identified in the genus Streptomyces and deletion of cutRS in Streptomyces coelicolor was shown to enhance antibiotic production, although its CutR regulon does not include any biosynthetic genes. Here, we used Streptomyces venezuelae to further investigate CutRS function. We show that deletion of cutRS leads to an increase in growth rate and a reversal of the typical glucose-mediated carbon catabolite repression typically observed in Streptomyces species. We also demonstrate that CutR DNA binding is glucose-dependent, but CutR does not directly regulate genes involved in growth, antibiotic biosynthesis, or glucose metabolism. The only CutR targets conserved in both S. coelicolor and S. venezuelae are the foldase genes htrA3 and htrB , which are involved in the protein secretion stress response. Consistent with this, we show that CutS homologues all contain two conserved cysteine residues in their extracellular sensor domains and that changing these residues to serine constitutively activates S. venezuelae CutRS. We propose that failure of a disulfide bond to form between these cysteine residues indicates secretion stress and leads to activation of the CutRS system and the secretion stress response.

IMPORTANCE

Streptomyces bacteria are the primary source of clinically useful antibiotics. While many two-component systems have been linked to antibiotic biosynthesis in Streptomyces species, few have been well characterized. Here, we characterize a secretion stress sensing two-component system called CutRS and propose a model for how the sensor kinase detects extracellular protein misfolding via two highly conserved cysteine residues. Importantly, we also show that deletion of cutRS triggers antibiotic overproduction in the presence of glucose. Since glucose normally represses antibiotic biosynthesis in Streptomyces species through carbon catabolite repression, this finding reveals a simple genetic route to bypass this barrier. This has significant implications for antibiotic discovery pipelines and industrial production, where glucose-rich media are preferred for cost and scalability. Our results position CutRS as a key target for future strain improvement strategies.
abstract_zh:
摘要

链霉菌的次级代谢产物占所有临床使用抗生素的一半以上，此外还包括众多抗真菌剂、抗癌化合物和免疫抑制剂。双组分系统在细菌中广泛存在，是链霉菌属抗生素生产的关键调控因子，然而其激活信号仍知之甚少。CutRS是链霉菌属中首个被鉴定的双组分系统，在天蓝色链霉菌（Streptomyces coelicolor）中删除cutRS被证明可增强抗生素生产，尽管其CutR调控子不包含任何生物合成基因。在此，我们利用委内瑞拉链霉菌（Streptomyces venezuelae）进一步研究CutRS功能。我们表明，删除cutRS导致生长速率增加，并逆转了链霉菌属中通常观察到的典型葡萄糖介导的碳分解代谢物阻遏效应。我们还证明，CutR DNA结合是葡萄糖依赖性的，但CutR不直接调控涉及生长、抗生素生物合成或葡萄糖代谢的基因。在S. coelicolor和S. venezuelae中唯一保守的CutR靶标是折叠酶基因htrA3和htrB，这些基因参与蛋白质分泌应激反应。与此一致，我们表明所有CutS同源物在其胞外传感器结构域中含有两个保守的半胱氨酸残基，将这些残基改为丝氨酸可组成性激活委内瑞拉链霉菌的CutRS。我们提出，这些半胱氨酸残基之间二硫键形成失败指示分泌应激，并导致CutRS系统和分泌应激反应的激活。

重要性

链霉菌属细菌是临床有用抗生素的主要来源。尽管许多双组分系统已与链霉菌属中的抗生素生物合成相关联，但很少有被充分表征的。在此，我们表征了一个名为CutRS的分泌应激感应双组分系统，并提出了一个模型，说明传感器激酶如何通过两个高度保守的半胱氨酸残基检测胞外蛋白错误折叠。重要的是，我们还表明，删除cutRS在葡萄糖存在下触发抗生素过量生产。由于葡萄糖通常通过碳分解代谢物阻遏抑制链霉菌属中的抗生素生物合成，这一发现揭示了一条绕过此屏障的简单遗传途径。这对抗生素发现流程和工业生产具有重要意义，在这些场景中，富含葡萄糖的培养基因成本和可扩展性而受到青睐。我们的结果将CutRS定位为未来菌株改良策略的关键靶点。
